title: 第27章 刘艺菲：不是，你真来啊？
content_zh:
王忠磊面露为难。

    和《英雄》一样的分成？

    人家《英雄》是什么片子，你这又是什么片子？

    虽然我对你自信，但人家院线都未必知道有你这么个人。

    王忠磊咬了咬牙道：“我可以尽量给你争取，但不能保证。”

    谷川也咬了咬牙：“那我也尽量和投资方争取，但不能保证。”

    王忠磊瞪了这个混蛋一眼。

    这小子不见兔子不撒鹰啊。

    “行，那我去给你争取，就算是谈不成《英雄》那个分成，但也尽量不差太多。”王忠磊说道。

    “好！我是相信王总的。”

    谷川也笑着说道：“我这就去投资方那边争取，就算是不能让华谊单独发行，也争取个联合发行。”

    王忠磊气得想要骂娘。

    他真的是一点一点往外挤啊，跟挤牙膏似的。

    两人相谈甚欢，算是达成了口头上的约定。

    至于具体的合作方式，还要等谷川和投资方谈过才行。

    谷川当天就离开了陆穿家，去买了点水果，打车去找投资人。

    “喂，小刘啊，我现在正在车上呢，马上就到你家了，待会你下来接我一下。”

    2月21日，正月初十。

    刘艺菲还窝在家里没出去工作，接到了一个令她十分不安的电话。

    她躲在卧室里，掰开门缝，偷偷看了一眼正在做饭的刘妈，回到卧室，压低了声音问道：“不是，你真的过来了？”

    “对啊，车上呢，马上就到了。”谷川说道。

    “你怎么知道我家在哪？”刘艺菲震惊地问道。

    “嘿嘿~”

    “你不会偷偷跟踪过我吧？”刘艺菲问道。

    “我不是那种人。”

    刘艺菲深吸一口气，问道：“你来我家做什么？”

    “就看看你，拜访一下。”

    “不用。”

    “我都路上了。”

    “那我出去。”刘艺菲咬着牙说道：“我们在外面见一面就好，你不用来我家。”

    “不是，我主要是想拜访一下阿姨。”谷川说道。

    刘艺菲气得胸脯鼓不起来。

    你拜访我妈做什么？

    咱俩什么关系啊，你就来拜访我妈？
content_en:
Wang Zhonglei looked embarrassed.

    The same share as "Heroes"?

    What kind of movie is "Hero", and what kind of movie is yours?

    Although I am confident in you, other movie theaters may not know that there is a person like you.

    Wang Zhonglei gritted his teeth and said, "I can try my best to fight for you, but I can't guarantee it."

    Tanichuan also gritted his teeth: "Then I will try my best to fight with investors, but I can't guarantee it."

    Wang Zhonglei glared at this bastard.

    This guy doesn't let go of the rabbit when he sees it.

    "Okay, then I will fight for you. Even if we can't negotiate the share of "Heroes", we will try not to be too far behind." Wang Zhonglei said.

    "Okay! I believe Mr. Wang."

    Tanichuan also smiled and said: "I will go to the investors to fight for it. Even if Huayi cannot issue it alone, I will strive for a joint issue."

    Wang Zhonglei was so angry that he wanted to scold his mother.

    He really squeezed it out little by little, like squeezing out toothpaste.

    The two chatted happily and finally reached a verbal agreement.

    As for the specific cooperation method, we have to wait for Tanichuan to discuss it with the investors.

    Tanichuan left Lu Chuan's house that day, went to buy some fruit, and took a taxi to find investors.

    "Hey, Xiao Liu, I'm in the car now. I'll be at your house soon. Come down and pick me up later."

    February 21st, the tenth day of the first lunar month.

    Liu Yifei was still staying at home without going out to work, when she received a very uneasy phone call.

    She hid in the bedroom, opened the door, and secretly glanced at Liu's mother who was cooking. She returned to the bedroom, lowered her voice and asked, "No, are you really here?"

    "Yes, it's in the car. It'll be there soon." Tanichuan said.

    "How do you know where my home is?" Liu Yifei asked in shock.

    "Hehe~"

    "You're not following me secretly, are you?" Liu Yifei asked.

    "I'm not that kind of person."

    Liu Yifei took a deep breath and asked, "Why did you come to my house?"

    "Just looking at you, visiting."

    "No need."

    "I'm on my way."

    "Then I'll go out." Liu Yifei gritted her teeth and said, "Just let's meet outside. You don't have to come to my house."

    "No, I mainly want to visit my aunt." Tanichuan said.

    Liu Yifei was so angry that her chest couldn't bulge.

    Why are you visiting my mother?

    What's the relationship between us? You just came to visit my mother?
title_en: Chapter 27 Liu Yifei: No, are you really here?
